1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 Bc5 4.c3 d6 5.d4.strategy: Recaptures and builds the pawn pair on d4 and e4, attacking the bishop again with gain of time. Black has to give ground in the centre once more, but the big centre needs support, and Black is well developed.

Retreats out of reach of the pawns while keeping the bishop on the diagonal that eyes d4 and f2. Black accepts White's big centre but has developed reasonably and aims to undermine it rather than hold it.
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 Bc5 4.c3 d6 5.d4.name: Italian Game: Classical Variation, La Bourdonnais Variation
